title: Commons Collections views update multiset size
summary: Removing a key through a live iterator can remove its membership while leaving aggregate size stale.

change.description: Removing a key through a live iterator can remove its membership while leaving aggregate size stale.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 18 inputs on each revision. parent mismatches were 18 for total, 0 for membership, 0 for otherCount. fix mismatches were 0 for total, 0 for membership, 0 for otherCount.

All six original native claims were decided using the selected JDK HashMap and its live key or entry iterator. With one A and one B, both JVMs removed A and retained one B. The parent reported total 2 and the fix reported 1. The parent total is wrong on all 18 inputs. Both revisions preserve membership and the other key’s multiplicity.
